metadata.rules_text:
- h1: keep unchanged; confidence=medium; reason=Base model h1 errors were mixed (overshoot and undershoot) with no consistent bias pattern in matched examples.
- h5: positive adjustment; confidence=high; magnitude=medium; reason=All three matched examples show significant base undershoot at h5, indicating a systematic downward bias requiring upward correction.
- h20: positive adjustment; confidence=high; magnitude=medium; reason=Consistent large undershoots in h20 across all examples (26-33%) confirm a strong base model bias needing upward adjustment.
- h30: positive adjustment; confidence=high; magnitude=medium; reason=Matched examples consistently show base forecasts significantly below actuals at h30, necessitating an upward correction.
